text:
rachel: Heads up — eu-west4 is showing a flurry of 'no scratch slots' errors and GPU attaches stuck in backoff. noticed after a spike in short-lived training jobs. anyone investigating? :eyes:
ben: i'm connected. `iostat -x 1 5` on a node shows nvme0 util ~99%, avg await 60-200ms. multiple janitor tasks started simultaneously. looks like a cleanup fanout + autoscale ripple.
infra-bot: ALERT: pool-eu-west4 scratch_iops_util > 91% for 10m. attach_fail_rate 14%.
diego: we recently moved reclamation earlier to reduce overnight backlog; suspect timing collided with scale. did we disable start-offsetting when we moved the window?
meera: yes — we toggled offsetting off to debug a latency regression last week and it never got turned back on for that pool.
rachel: oof. two fixes: throttle janitor concurrency + apply a soft reserve of scratch slots for critical attaches. can we toggle both quickly?
ben: quick mitigation plan: 1) set janitor.concurrency=1 2) enable scrub_start_jitter=600 3) create attach policy: prefer nodes with free_scratch_slots>=4 and soft_reserve=2. will test in canary az first.
diego: also temporarily deprioritize non-interactive batches in scheduler (weight +20) while we stabilize.
meera: commands i'm about to run on control plane:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --patch '{"data":{"concurrency":"1","startJitterSeconds":"600"}}'
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"name":"scratch-soft-reserve","expr":"free_scratch_slots - soft_reserve >= 2","params":{"soft_reserve":"2"}}'
# scheduler tweak
kubectl -n infra patch deployment scheduler --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"batch-priority-shift":"true"}}}}}'
```
ben: applied to canary at 4333333370. attach queue in that AZ dropped 120->30 in 40s. nvme util decreased to ~55-70%.
rachel: nice. rollout strategy? we should avoid toggling all regions at once to prevent synchronized scrub starts.
diego: will stagger by AZ with 45s spacing. also schedule re-enable of deep-verify later with high jitter and low concurrency.
meera: logging: adding metric `scratch_soft_reserve_active` and alert if attach latency > 3s for 5m during rollout.
infra-bot: NOTE: change applied by ben at 4333333372. rollback window 4333333732 if attach success < 90% or errors spike.
rachel: post-incident items: - audit why startJitter was disabled - add pre-scale hook to block janitor window within 15m of autoscale events - consider proactive reservation for high-priority attaches. owner: infra/storage.
diego: longer term: scheduler should use per-node iops_budget and upcoming janitor schedule to make placement decisions. file follow-up RFC.
meera: i'll update runbook and run a simulated scale+cleanup test in staging.
ben: monitoring looks stable so far; rolling to remaining AZs. keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
